The available project files confirm a 187-monster regional roster, but they do not expose one consolidated list of all 187 identities. To protect the dex from made-up names/types, this workbook fully balances every recoverable monster and leaves the other working slots explicitly unresolved. Working Slot is an internal workbook tracker, not final Pokédex numbering. Once the canonical roster list is available, the blank rows can be populated without changing the balance framework.
